test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Who was nominated as the Ambassador of India to the Republic of Madagascar, in September 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bandaru Wilsonbabu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bandaru Wilsonbabu:**

 
 
• **In 2004, Mr. Bandaru Wilsonbabu became a member of the Indian Foreign Service. **
 
• From 2014 to 2016, Mr. Bandaru served as Deputy Secretary in the Ministry of External Affairs in New Delhi.
 
• He served as a counselor at the Indian Embassy in Beijing **from 2016 until 2020**. He served as **India's Permanent Delegate to the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) Secretariat in Beijing** during this time. 
 
• **From 2020 until 2022**, he worked in New Delhi as the **Director and Joint Secretary of the Ministry of External Affairs.**
 
• **In September 2022, Shri Bandaru Wilsonbabu was appointed as the Indian ambassador to the Republic of Madagascar.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Abhay Kumar:**

 
 
• **In 2003, he enlisted in the Indian Foreign Service.**
 
• From 2016 to 2019, he was India's deputy ambassador to Brazil. 
 
• **From 2019 to 2022, he represented India as its 21st ambassador to Comoros and Madagascar.**
 
• He is currently employed at the Indian Council for Cultural Relations (ICCR) in New Delhi as the deputy director general.
 
 
 
• **Naveen Srivastava:**
 
 
• **In 1993, he enlisted in the Indian Foreign Service.**
 
• From August 2015 to May 2017, he was the Indian ambassador to the Kingdom of Cambodia.
 
• He served as the director general and corporate secretary of the New Development Bank (NDB) in Shanghai, China, on deputation from June 2017 until June 2019.
 
• **On June 25, 2022**, he took office as **India's ambassador to Nepal.**
 
 
 
• **Manpreet Vohra:**
 
 
• **In 1988, he enlisted in the Indian Foreign Service.**
 
• From 2011 until 2015, he represented India as ambassador to Bolivia and Peru.
 
• He was the Indian ambassador to Mexico from 2019 to 2021 while also holding the position of High Commissioner to Belize.
 
• **He was named the Indian High Commissioner to Australia in 2021, a position he held until December 2023.**
